story.title: A practical answer to a local trust problem.
story.copy: In many Indian cities, people still find professionals through references, calls, shop boards or scattered online listings. That can work, but it often leaves customers unsure about credentials, process, documents and reliability.

items.title: The problem
items.copy: Important work like legal help, GST, property papers and government documentation needs more confidence than a random contact number.

items.title: Why we exist
items.copy: KaunBatayega was created to bring verified professionals, structured profiles and simple discovery into one trusted experience.

items.title: For customers
items.copy: Customers should be able to compare providers, understand service categories and begin with more clarity.

items.title: For providers
items.copy: Professionals should get a credible digital presence, verification status and tools to manage future enquiries.

mission.missionCopy: Help Indian customers start important service work with verified professionals, clearer expectations and a more organized experience.
mission.visionTitle: Build India's trusted local service network.
mission.visionCopy: Create a dependable platform where customers can discover serious professionals and providers can grow with credibility, transparency and better digital tools.

faq.title: Common questions about KaunBatayega.
faq.copy: Clear answers for customers and professionals.

items.question: What is KaunBatayega?
items.answer: KaunBatayega is a trusted service marketplace that helps customers discover verified professionals across legal, GST, property, documentation, government and essential service categories.

items.question: How are providers verified?
items.answer: Providers submit profile information and required documents. The admin team reviews identity, professional details and documents before approval.

items.question: Who can become a provider?
items.answer: Lawyers, CAs, GST consultants, property consultants, documentation experts, insurance advisors, electricians, government consultants and other serious service professionals can apply.

items.question: How do customers connect?
items.answer: Customer-side access is being prepared. The public site currently helps users understand services while the verified provider network is built.

items.question: Is registration free?
items.answer: Provider account creation is available for onboarding. Any future paid plans or upgrades will be shown clearly before activation.

items.question: Can providers offer multiple services?
items.answer: Yes. Providers can select relevant categories and services during registration, subject to verification and admin review.

items.question: How long does verification take?
items.answer: Verification usually completes within 24-48 hours after complete and readable documents are submitted.

items.question: Can I update my profile?
items.answer: Yes. Providers can update profile details from the dashboard after account onboarding.
